title: simply amazing
body:
i rarely write reviews for apps but i am so impressed with this app & what it's capable of. i have bounced from app to app trying to find a good tracker for fitness and daily routine tasks but grit is the only
app that has been able to tick all the boxes and even more, i didn't even consider tracking my "bad habits" until i saw the option in grit. the level of detail you're able to add such as groups, sub groups, colours, icons, calendar integration (and more) is just amazing.
and the price... when i saw that grit had a subscription i was disappointed but then i saw how well priced it was, 19.99$ (aud) for a year is amazing, i'll be keeping this subscription & continue to support this great app. 
ps for the adhd homies out there, this is the one
11/10 highly recommend

author: modrs

title: Awesome
body:
This is an excellent habit tracker. One thing to note is that nearly all trackers allow you to select a good or bad habit but not to simply track a habit. This is one of the only ones I found that allowed you to create a habit and then track it without having to be forced to set a goal number.

In fact the way this can be used to track all sorts of things like exercise, sleep ect. I think the developers realise this due to the apple health integration but ultimately this app may be more valuable in its ability to track things generally as opposed to habits specifically. For example, if they allowed custom measurement units to be add you could set up a ‘habit’ with things like your vo2max or other vitals. There is a hole in the market for just a general flexible tracking app that you put health data in. Basic blood test could be logged in a format like this too.

Lots of potential for this app if they push it into a general tracker.
author: Braizo9000

title: The best habit tracker I’ve found!!
body: There are so many habit tracking apps and I think I’ve tried most of them. Grit is the first one that ticks all the boxes for me - attractive UI, lots of different ways to measure (including a timer that will KEEP GOING if you exceed your goal), ability to colour code and group habits, widgets, Watch app. It’s fantastic and I will subscribe as soon as my free trial ends.
